scoped_dependencies.relation: The controlled survival compiler and posterior application invoke the packet marked first-hit CDF primitive. Source-reported logical dependency only; N663 is not thereby validated.

failure: Failure: The compiler relies on the internal marked-CDF primitive in N663. The polylog-rank tier is not separately coded or interval-certified; the implemented tier is numerical. Posterior selection includes a log(1/w) rare-history cost and is myopic, not general multistep planning.
interface: Interface: Piecewise explicit rational controls on independent two-state coordinates, finite explicit target/detector configurations and product initial state. The survival compiler returns an approximate signed-product representation. The posterior operation observes finite click/no-click outcomes and chooses from a finite explicit experiment menu.

claims.title: Boundary-event compression supports controlled survival mixtures and sparse-sensor choice
